message: Moe Icons export '{name}' is not available in this installed module.
hint: Run `moeicons generate` after changing the selected icons, then check the generated export. If generation fails, run `moeicons doctor`.

message: Moe Icons opening and closing component tags do not match.
hint: Use matching opening and closing component names.

message: Moe Icons symbol '{name}' cannot be used as a JSX component.
hint: Use a component export in JSX; call Vanilla factories as functions.

message: This icon's configured styles include Pro resources; the current account has no confirmed active Pro entitlement.
hint: Check the Moe Icons account view or run `moeicons login`. Pro icons require an active Pro entitlement.

message: The installed Moe Icons resource version differs from this plugin's bundled metadata.
hint: Install or generate the intended resource version, or update the plugin. The version map records verified combinations.

message: The CLI account session has expired.
hint: Run `moeicons login` in a terminal on this VS Code host, then refresh the account view.

message: The Moe Icons account status is temporarily unavailable.
hint: Check network/proxy, run `moeicons doctor`, or upgrade to Node.js 24 and reinstall the CLI, then retry.

message: No Moe Icons CLI session was found on this VS Code host.
hint: Run `moeicons login` in a terminal on this host, then refresh the account view. Remote SSH, WSL and containers need their own login; local credentials are not copied.

message: The CLI session store could not be read safely.
hint: Run `moeicons login` again. On Linux ensure `secret-tool`/libsecret is installed; on macOS ensure the `security` command works; in a container or remote host log in there.

message: The Moe Icons account service is rate limiting this host.
hint: Wait before retrying and use Refresh Account; do not sign in repeatedly.

message: The account service rejected this request under its policy.
hint: Verify your account and plan status on moeicons.com. If the CLI fails too, upgrade to Node.js 24 and the CLI, then retry.

message: No Moe Icons CLI project or installation was found in this workspace.
hint: Install Node.js 24, install the CLI with `npm install -D @moewolf/moe-icons-cli@latest`, then run `npx moeicons init` from the project root.

message: The Moe Icons project exists but has no CLI-generated install metadata.
hint: Run `npx moeicons init`, `npx moeicons install free`, and `npx moeicons generate` from the project root.

message: CLI install metadata or the generated catalog is invalid or unreadable.
hint: Regenerate with `npx moeicons generate`. Do not hand-edit `.moeicons` files; run `npx moeicons doctor` if it repeats.

message: The installed Moe Icons CLI metadata uses an unsupported schema.
hint: Upgrade to Node.js 24 and reinstall/upgrade the Moeicons CLI, then run init/install/generate. Update the plugin if the CLI is already current.

message: CLI-generated files differ from the hashes recorded in install metadata.
hint: Run `npx moeicons generate` to regenerate them; do not hand-edit generated files.

message: This project was generated by an unsupported Moeicons CLI version.
hint: Upgrade to Node.js 24, reinstall/upgrade the Moeicons CLI, then run init/install/generate.
